description: Download a completed clip (kind "clip", default; same as `clipugc videos download <id>`) or a completed finished video (kind "finished"; same as `clipugc finished download <videoId>`) to a local mp4 file. Pass an absolute output path; missing parent directories are created. Costs no credits. Fails if the video has not completed yet.

id.description: Clip or finished video id, as returned by other tools (numbers are fine as strings).

kind.description: "clip" (default) for a clip id, "finished" for a finished video id (merged_video_id).

output.description: Destination file path (same as --output). Default: clipugc-video-<id>.mp4 or clipugc-finished-<id>.mp4 in the server's working directory.

name: download_video
title: Download a clip or finished video
